QuestInfo.name: [Event] Claim the Dice Master Reward
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Dice Master> Event#n
#b[Event Details]#k
Enjoy the #eDice Master#n game designed by #b#p9400493##k. It's a mini-game that mimics a classic dice-rolling board game! Roll to move, and the space you land on will give you either a reward or a mission. #bYour goal is to use 10 dice to reach the end of the board.#k #rRewards#k are determined by how many times you clear the game!

#b[Event Entry Method]#k
#b[Event Entry Method]#k
#b#e#i4009446:# #t4009446##n#k x10 are required to enter the #eDice Master#n game. Hunt monsters near your level to have a chance of getting the dice.
#eMonsters near your level#n are monsters as many as #r20 levels below you, or 20 levels above you#k.
